recipe: import json;d=json.load(open('options.json'));o=d['options'];b=max(x['steps'][-1]['score'] for x in o);p=o[min((x['steps'][-1]['disruption']['score'],i) for i,x in enumerate(o) if x['steps'][-1]['score']>=b-1)[1]];s=[t['score'] for t in p['steps']];r=next(i for i,v in enumerate(s) if v>=s[0]+d['share']*(s[-1]-s[0])-1e-9);print(r)
